title: line
body:
## line

Creates a straight polyline from start to end with resolution intervals (Schemaxis default 20, so 21 points), as a separate polydata source. Connect it to streamTracer.seed to place streamline seeds, or use it as probe geometry; it is not the velocity dataset and carries no fields. To sample fields along a segment use probeLine.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Coordinates use the dataset coordinate system. A line inside the bounding box can still cross solid regions or gaps.
- Resolution is the number of intervals, so a line with resolution 20 has 21 points.

Native constructor: `Line`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | First endpoint as [X, Y, Z], in the same world-coordinate system as the dataset. Use preview bounds to locate it. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[-1,0,0]` | `[-1,0,0]` |
| `end` | Second endpoint as [X, Y, Z]. Choose a different point from the start to define a nonzero line. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[1,0,0]` | `[1,0,0]` |
| `resolution` | Number of intervals along the line; N intervals give N+1 points. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":1}` | `20` | `20` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "line"
}
```
